properties.name: ПІСЛЯСВІТ 3D — Обсерваторія v0.9.21 · контакт і світлова пляма
properties.description: Isolated Observatory visual readability pass: solid blue depth sky and three neon-lit projector face billboards, higher-contrast transparent cones. Original source 0.9.6 movement/optics and checkpoint logic unchanged. | v0.9.4: neon 3D asset integration after visual references: curved-leg spider, pink and cyan coral, anemones, two spotlight variants, console and platform modules. Original puzzle/physics/camera unchanged. | v0.9.5 dark underwater depth; procedural 3D ruins, observatory domes and fish; corrected clipped lights, spider facing and distracting underfloor teeth; unchanged gameplay. | Full scene single-screen fixed 3D camera; full-level puzzle composition and playable geometry maintained. | v0.9.7: cinematic camera intro zoom on Spalakh, reveal entire puzzle at switch A, close escape shot near exit; lower viewing angle 82 degrees. No puzzle geometry or asset changes. | v0.9.8: intro zoom returns when Spalakh backtracks; slower camera zoom transitions; lower almost side-on view; late-night underwater lighting. | v0.9.9: 8 new real GLB art assets (7 families): smooth rounded pink coral and cyan anemone, dark spider with pink-cyan legs and glowing eyes, dark matte hanging/standing projector with emissive lens only, industrial switch with tiny indicator only, soft gradient stone platform block. Gameplay camera, collision geometry and puzzle code unchanged. | v0.9.10 material, lighting and FX only: 7 refreshed GLB material skins; glowing corals and anemones via original emissive; readable spider gradients via Basic unlit shader; matte lamp and console housing with emissive lens/indicator; brighter moonlit stone; underwater atmospheric background image, depth mist, local nonshadow cyan/magenta/blue lights; transparent bridge glow. Identical camera and gameplay logic. | v0.9.11: GLB volumetric Spalakh character with 4 embedded keyframe animations Idle, Run, Jump, Fall; articulated rig with animated arms, legs, head, hair, embers. GDevelop Player object replaces old hidden GLB and sprite frame swapping; original 2D sprites retained but hidden. No gameplay, physics, camera or puzzle change. | v0.9.12: repaired six NaN flame mesh position/normal buffers in animated GLB; keep-aspect volumetric character with bottom-centered pivot and world-ground positioning; controls, physics, optics, camera unchanged. | v0.9.13: place genuine animated 3D Player at camera-facing Y=185, clear of stage platform front-face Y=115, avoiding severe depth occlusion. Preserve Z-ground/puzzle movement, all four GLB animations, 3D camera and original optics. | v0.9.14: brand-new GLB filename and Player instance to bypass stale bounds; explicitly sized model 132x108x225 with keepAspectRatio disabled; force pivot at feet, camera-facing orientation, move in front of stage and align glow; no changes to camera or puzzle physics. | v0.9.15: native GDevelop 3D hybrid with latest v084e 2D Spalakh sprite animations (Idle 6, Run 7, Jump 3, Fall 3, Land 4); original scripted controls, bridge and camera unchanged. Old GLB Player removed from scene. | v0.9.16: fix upside-down duplicate sprites when moving left by replacing 180-degree panel rotation with native GDevelop 3D flipX; model physics, camera, puzzle optics unchanged. | v0.9.17: replaced corrupted 0.9.10 Moon asset references with validated intact v0.9.9 GLBs, preserving silhouettes and original optics; spider restores vertex color with KeepOriginal rather than GDevelop Basic; sprite panels render only their camera-facing face to prevent duplicated upside-down reverse image. | v0.9.18: correct 2D frame UV orientation with faceOrientation=Z and inverse X mirror, align foot baseline, attach tilted cone planes to real 3D spotlight origins and targets; animate two red neon eyes and a point light for each spider. Camera, controls, puzzle physics unchanged. | v0.9.19: align the 2.5D Spalakh camera-facing XZ sprite depth with physical GDevelop 3D platform volumes (Y=-8 vs invalid front Y=158), anchor sprite bottom to worldZ(s.y)+2 for floors, raised ledges, light bridge, and jumping. Physics, camera, optical puzzles, animations and neon spider eye work unchanged. | v0.9.20: individual visual foot baselines for Idle/Run/Jump/Fall/Land, latched surface class during air time and depth corrections for thick main stage; six spherical emissive GLB eyes attached to the spider heads replace red squares and old halos; original GDevelop camera and puzzle logic unchanged. | v0.9.21: fix lower thick-platform and light-bridge screen-space visual foot alignment with inward depth placement and small lift; visually snap feet to collidable ledge edges while keeping physics untouched; use correctly horizontal top-face glow decal at collider height; keep upper-ledge anchors, spider eye GLB, optics and camera unchanged.

inlineCode: // ПІСЛЯСВІТ — ОБСЕРВАТОРІЯ ХИБНОГО СВІТЛА • 3D CINEMATIC NIGHT v0.9.8
// One scene. Three refractors reconfigure light as shelter and physical bridge.
message:'ОПТИЧНІ ПРИСТРОЇ МОЖНА ПОВЕРТАТИ КЛАВІШЕЮ E.',messageClock:5.7,
// M1: physical bridge and a hand-off safe pool at its far shore.
// M2: a walking spotlight, then a fixed beam that doubles as iris input.
// M3: a rehearsal arc or long final cover.
['ПЕРШИЙ ПРОМІНЬ — У ЛІВИЙ КУТ','СВІТЛОВИЙ МІСТ МАТЕРІАЛІЗУВАВСЯ!','ПЕРШИЙ ПРОМІНЬ — ДО ПАВУКІВ'],
['ДРУГЕ ДЗЕРКАЛО — ВГОРУ','ПРОМІНЬ РУХАЄТЬСЯ. МОЖНА ЙТИ РАЗОМ ІЗ НИМ!','ДРУГИЙ ПРОМІНЬ ЗАКРІПИВСЯ НА ОПТИЧНОМУ ЗАМКУ'],
['ТРЕТЄ ДЗЕРКАЛО — ВГОРУ','ТРЕТІЙ ПРОМІНЬ КОЛИВАЄТЬСЯ','ТРЕТІЙ ПРОМІНЬ ОСВІТЛЮЄ ВИХІД']
if(irisOpen())announce('ДВА ПРОМЕНІ ПЕРЕТНУЛИСЯ — ОПТИЧНА ПЕРЕГОРОДКА РОЗКРИЛАСЯ!',4.2);
// The optical iris is a wall, not just a decorative goal marker.
// E operates one refractor at a time. No speed skill, throwing, lifting, switches, locks, keys.
// Spiders are vision-based only. Being inside ANY light zone is invisibility.
if(irisOpen()&&hidden()){s.won=true;s.flash=1;announce('ОБСЕРВАТОРІЮ ПРОЙДЕНО! ТИ ЗІБРАВ КОРИДОР ІЗ ПРОМЕНІВ.',99);}
// v0.9.20: per-frame contact anchors. Game collision coordinates remain authoritative.
// Surface classification is latched while airborne: jumping cannot move the sprite between 3D depth lanes.
// Each PNG frame has its own visual foot baseline (in GDevelop 3D world units).
// Keeping the base near the physical floor prevents hovering on narrow ledges.
// Bridge has a different stage geometry; classify it separately from the main floor.
// Surface offsets tune projected foot contact, not the actual collision.
// Main-floor & bridge models are deep slabs: draw the character farther inside them
// so the top surface, not the near vertical face, is the visual contact plane.
// Keep the sprite stable when moving from one collider to another.
// GDevelop platform collision permits 13px horizontal overlap at ledge edges.
// Prevent the visible foot silhouette looking detached while the collision body still stands.
// Texture lies on a vertical XZ face; Z here is the bottom of the image plane.
// Horizontal transparent decal on the deck, never the platform's vertical front wall.
// The decal is positioned below the sprite but only 2 world-units above the real collider.
// Neon front badges face the camera even when GLB materials are one-sided in Preview.
// Render exactly three cyan beam cones tied to real optics, not decorative fake safe zones.
// Every light cone is now geometrically attached to its own hanging 3D spotlight.
// Center the beam rectangle between the lamp lens and the physical illuminated spot.
// Each spider uses two emissive, spherical GLB eyes anchored to the front of its head.
// GDevelop 3D: Z is vertical, Y is front/back. No more red boxes under the spider.
let task=!bridge()?'01 / ПУЛЬТ A: ПОВЕРНИ ПРОМІНЬ ТА СТВОРИ СВІТЛОВИЙ МІСТ [E].'
:!s.crossed?'02 / ПЕРЕЙДИ ПРОВАЛЛЯ ТА ЗНАЙДИ ПУЛЬТ B.'
:s.modes[2]===0?'04 / РУХАЙСЯ РАЗОМ ІЗ ПРОМЕНЕМ ДО ПУЛЬТА C.'
:!irisOpen()?'06 / ПЕРЕНАЛАШТУЙ ПУЛЬТ B ДЛЯ ВІДКРИТТЯ ЗАТВОРА.'
if(s.won)task='ОБСЕРВАТОРІЮ ПРОЙДЕНО — ТИ ПРОКЛАВ ШЛЯХ ІЗ СВІТЛА.';
// CAMERA v0.9.8: smooth cinematic close / full reveal / exit with a near-side angle.
// The intro returns whenever Spalakh walks back to the left start area.
// Slow frame-rate-independent interpolation for focal point, zoom and camera angle.

'The player lands back at the height it jumped from.'
